goal: Ensure POST requests to /rest/getutxos find valid outpoints instead of incorrectly reporting no hit
Align POST behavior with GET queries so REST clients get accurate UTXO results
Cap input vector allocation and reject trailing or malformed request bytes
agreement: Substantive support with no open objections
Verified locally by reproducing the issue and confirming matching responses (Zeegaths)
Tested 14 POST bodies in binary and hex on regtest to confirm expected responses (fametrano)
Open suggestion to return HTTP 400 when a POST body contains no outpoints (fametrano)

why: P2 because it fixes a correctness bug causing false negative UTXO results for REST clients
